decisions.rationale: Decided: Firstmate decision react-forms-loop4-correction (inbox 016, 2026-11-18) authorized one bounded fourth correction loop: the label query scoped to the submitted form with a fail-closed message, a complementary team-value variant instead of narrowed wording, the split-test expected-output wording, the wrapped and completed starter hint including notify, and an accurate message for empty or todo-only learner files. Implemented at commit 044631bf (044631bf21b8379686296ca9e885a736707c8b95); current lab.json sha256 5fa2f584.... The loop-5 education recheck marks this finding resolved. Verified: tests/task8-variant.jsx now finds the name and team fields with the Testing Library label query, scoped to the submitted form. With only the team caption changed to a label wrapping the select, the solved test is accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0, and a blank-only partial test on the same form is still rejected with the four completed-submission messages. With the name label replaced by a span referenced through aria-labelledby, the solved test is accepted. The fail-closed path was exercised by pointing a scratch-only copy of the variant at a caption the form does not have: npm test then exits 1 with the single learner-safe message that the check could not find the 'Service name' and 'Owning team' fields by their labels, instead of the old misleading 'add this check' lines. Reconciler-verified at 044631bf in a fresh 0700 scratch copy made with git archive, with the private overlay copied over the starter (macOS darwin, Node 24.2.0, npm 11.3.0). The shipped starter still fails all 8 tests and the oracle is not reached; the private solution passes 8/8 and prints the Task 8 line with exit 0. See coding-lab-loop4-reconciliation.json for the original reproduction and escalation.

Implemented at commit 044631bf (044631bf21b8379686296ca9e885a736707c8b95); current lab.json sha256 5fa2f584.... Partly implemented; recorded honestly. The loop-5 SME recheck marks it open as partly fixed. Fixed: a learner file holding only a test.todo named like the task 8 test plus a skipped test now gets 'no runnable test was found in starter/src/service-form.test.jsx ... todo and skipped tests do not count' with exit 1, which is accurate (reconciler-verified at 044631bf). Per the loop-5 SME recheck, an empty file and an imports-only file never reach the oracle, because Vitest's own accurate 'No test suite found' message fails the normal run (critic-reported, not rerun). Not fixed: with starter/src/service-form.test.jsx deleted, the normal run shows 'Tests  7 passed (7)' and npm test still prints the old 'your test fails against an unchanged copy of your finished form' message with exit 1 (reconciler-reproduced at 044631bf). The control run finds no test files and exits non-zero, so it takes the failing-control branch. The verdict is correct and only the diagnosis is wrong, for a learner who deletes the file the lab gives them. The decision is accept because the finding is true and the part Firstmate authorized for empty and todo-only files is implemented. The deleted-file residual is a low, diagnosis-only gap; closing it (treat a control report with zero test results as the no-runnable case whatever the exit status, or pass --passWithNoTests to the variant runs) would be a fifth correction loop. Firstmate's decision says no fifth loop starts without a new decision, and the reconciler does not recommend one for this residual. It stays recorded here as known and unfixed.
